name: Clean girl
summary: A look of dewy skin, a sleek bun, gold hoops, neutral clothes, white tiles and tidy shelves. It grew on TikTok and Instagram in 2021 and 2022 and sells wellness, skin and routine.

philosophy.core_thesis: Show effortless order: a polished, neutral surface suggests a calm life, and the routine is the product.
design_principles: Set the ground in warm white (#FAF7F2) with beige (#E9DFD1) and a soft taupe (#9C8B7A) as support.
Use one gold accent (#C8A25B) for hoops, rules and small marks, under 5% of the surface.
Pair a clean geometric sans with one fine display serif or italic at 40px to 96px.
Photograph skin, hands and objects in soft window light with a 3% bloom and a visible sheen on highlights.
Frame products on white tile, marble or linen, in rows of 3 with 24px gaps; keep a 4:5 crop.
Show routines as numbered steps: 01 Cleanse, 02 Hydrate, 03 Glow, each in a pill of 999px radius.
Round all corners at 24px or more and use shadows at 6% opacity only.

layout.grid_mechanics: A 12-column grid with 24px gutters; products and steps sit in rows of 3 on tile modules of 160px.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 45% to 60% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 24, 40 and 64px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred headings and centred product rows; text sits in short blocks of 3 lines.
layout.container_geometry: Cards and pills with a 24px to 999px radius, a 1px beige border and a 0 8px 24px shadow at 6% opacity.

font_pairings.note: A fine, narrow serif with an italic for one soft headline word, and a geometric sans for text.
A clean low-contrast geometric sans for labels and routines.
A calm, round sans pair for interface text.

hierarchy_rules: Use weights 300 and 500 for the sans.
Set one word of each heading in serif italic.
Set step numbers in small capitals with 0.08em tracking.

color.palette_structure: Warm whites and beiges with a taupe text and one gold accent.
color.contrast_rules: Taupe ink on warm white holds 12:1; stone holds 5.5:1; gold and beige carry rules, pills and fills, not small text.
color.surface_treatment: Smooth fills with a faint 2-stop gradient from #FFFFFF to #F2EBDF; a soft sheen on photographs.
color.light_and_shadow: Soft window light; a bloom of 3% on highlights; shadows lifted and blurred at 24px.

materiality.surface_simulation: White tile, marble, linen, gold wire, serum glass and slick skin.
materiality.border_rules: A 1px beige line on cards; pills with a 999px radius.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: A shadow of 0 8px 24px at 6% opacity; no glass and no hard edge.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin outline icons at 24px with 1.25px strokes and round caps; no tile.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Close photographs of skin, hoops, a sleek bun, a glass bottle and a white tiled shelf; no drawn illustration.

motion.transition_physics: Smooth and soft: elements fade up by 8px over 450ms; a sheen passes over a product at 3s per loop.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover lifts a card by 3px and sweeps a sheen; active state returns it in 150ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels calm, tidy and drawn to a polished daily routine.

avoid_when: The brand needs rebellion, mess or loud colour.
The audience reads a dense technical product page.
The tone must be dark, raw or ironic.

modifiers.how: Remove the sheen and gold; use a flat grey ground and a denim blue.
Replace the beige with one hot pink and add glossy plastic highlights.
Use a deeper taupe palette, wider margins and no routine steps.

pack.why: A very thin line set that matches the soft, light feel of the look.

ground.why: The clean girl look stands on a soft, near-white ground with a faint warm glow, like a bathroom in morning light.
